definition.certified: mask QA passes AND model prediction <= theta (level default_level)
definition.risk: CRC loss per capture = mean over its measured cracks of 1[certified]*1[wrong]; E[loss] <= alpha_cal (Angelopoulos et al. ICLR 2024); exchangeable unit = capture drawn from gate_degrade.DIST applied to a source photo of the printed panel; default_level is meta-calibrated on grouped held-out splits
definition.prediction: pred ~ log(|err|/tol): monotone-constrained gradient boosted trees on gate.FEATURES
definition.width_convention: true width = full printed stroke width of the panel (not an operator black-core width)

ood.note: design features worse than the 99.9th percentile of the calibration data are out of range: not certified

reference.note: median design vector of certified calibration rows

u_res.source: krkcmd_metrics.csv, calib=added, estimator loc_fwhm, PSF 0.75 px
